curriculum_mapping.target: A general outcomes 1, 2 and 4; S1 pp. 31–32. Everyday reactions, evidence, classification and consequences.
A general outcomes 2 and 3; S1 pp. 31–32. Formulas, equations and element-by-element atom conservation. Scientific reference: S2.
B general outcomes 1–3; S1 pp. 36–37. Energy pathways, converters, useful output and biological energy change; selected generation contexts from outcome 2.
B general outcome 2; S1 p. 37. Energy use, power, efficiency and household decisions. Unit reference: S3.
C general outcomes 1–3 and 5; S1 pp. 42–43. Transmission, prevention, body defences and community health. Scientific references: S4–S5.
C general outcome 4; S1 p. 43. Simple autosomal inheritance, Punnett squares and pedigrees. Probability reference: S6.
D general outcomes 1 and 2; S1 p. 48. Reaction travel, speed, distance, time and graphs.
D general outcomes 3 and 4; S1 p. 49. Momentum, impulse, collision duration and protection. Scientific references: S7–S8.
